Flower-Souls.personality: Children's souls growing as flowers in Mother Flower's garden in the sky
Flower-Souls.playsLike: Tend the garden: heal your units and let them grow

lore.creature: Mẻ Bjoóc (Mother Flower) and her flower-souls
lore.from: Tày and Nùng folk belief, northeastern Vietnam (Cao Bằng, Lạng Sơn)
lore.title: The Flower-Souls
lore.eyebrow: Tày folk belief · the garden in the sky
facts: The Tày and Nùng of northern Vietnam say that Mẻ Bjoóc, Mother Flower, keeps a flower garden in the sky.
Every child's soul grows in her garden as a flower: gold flowers for boys, silver flowers for girls.
Mother Flower hands the flowers down to the families who will have children.
When a child's soul wanders off, a Then singer journeys up to the sky garden to tend the roots of the child's flower.
Families keep a small altar for Mother Flower, with a paper flower on it.
